notes.title: Upcoming Demo 3 Version Update Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/4387f226f03db699e0e7ce437a7a9528cca602e9.png[/img]

Hello, this is Tentacle Soft.
Thank you so much for your interest in Hellgate Reiko.

Here’s a preview of the main content included in the upcoming update.


1. Reward Card System Overhaul
The reward card system granted after clearing each floor has been completely revamped.

Previously, the system allowed you to simply add, remove, or change cards.
Now, you will be presented with a selection of special reward cards after clearing a floor,
and you can choose one to build your deck using the card's unique effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/9a22d11bd31a16d590be0f674fc3eb83d72d189d.gif[/img]
There are currently 30 reward cards available,
and many more with unique effects are planned for future updates.


2. Examples of Reward Card Effects
- Value Boost Cards: Add +5, +10, +15, etc. to a randomly chosen card
- Conditional Effect Cards: Halve the value if even, double it if odd
- Directional Spread Cards: Apply +2, +4, +6... to cards on the right
- Position-Based Cards: +50 if the selected card is in a corner, -10 if in the center

More cards with creative and strategic effects are already in development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/01de260d8ae5c2905ccf1d8477b705b3a62cbef8.gif[/img]
Vampire Card: Halves the selected card’s value and distributes it to the adjacent cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/e9f3c7bfa3549b02b4d2fb8437df35994ecf81d0.gif[/img]
Rainy Day Card: Increases the value of cards on the same odd/even position as the selected one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/a041592d5a0ea2d4e7e7dc49bbd41c7bc5705475.gif[/img]
World Tree Card: Increases the value of all cards surrounding the selected one.


We’re continuing to add more exciting and strategic cards to the game.
Thank you for your patience and support — we look forward to bringing you the next version soon!

(※ This content is under development and may be subject to change upon release.)

notes.title: Demo 2 Version Update News! (2025-04-27)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/4387f226f03db699e0e7ce437a7a9528cca602e9.png[/img]

Hello, this is Tentacle Soft.

We sincerely thank everyone who showed interest and provided valuable feedback on the previous demo version.
Thanks to your input, we were able to discover and fix parts we had missed, and prepare this demo update.
And finally! Based on the ECG we previously showed, we have added our first Dialogue Event! Now Reiko can proudly 〇〇-debut!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/373194db3c689fc982a755545b5110ef1b3e1c08.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/2e970977ac0aeeabec18f52b8bf2863dcb93a7a2.png[/img]

Here are the details of this demo update:
1. Stage Clear Reward Dialogue Event added (triggered after clearing Floor 20)
2. Gallery System Update and Collection Feature Added (Weapons/Relics/Monsters)
3. Tooltip Additions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/a2422b69fdca18b26f4c221f68642f26c033f2c1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/7854d0882302ee53b7163b77322bc63c25e092de.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/43c000e562039a1e66a0a4013994293ae4a8cb18.png[/img]
4. Point Shop update: Costume system moved from PlayScene Inventory to Point Shop
5. Key Binding and Volume Control settings added
6. Weapon Draw UI updated to allow choosing placement position
7. Story Revision (Reiko changed from CEO to New Employee)
8. Poker Hand Relics added
9. Shortcut Keys added to PlayScene
10. Hold Aim Key added
11. Reward Card System changed (no more card add events, now a roulette system)

Currently, "Hellgate Reiko" is progressing under three development focuses: System Updates, Balance Updates, and Event (Dialogue) Updates.
This update mainly focused on system improvements, but we plan to address balance issues in upcoming patches.
※ Save data will be maintained through balance updates.

Next Update Goals:
1. Classic Mode Deck revision and new Reward Card events
2. Change Pick Card grade standards (e.g., 30/100/200/500/1000)
3. Add new relics matching the new grade system
4. Add Menhera Mode Version 1

We look forward to seeing you again in the next update!
Thank you!

notes.title: Upcoming Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/4387f226f03db699e0e7ce437a7a9528cca602e9.png[/img]

Hello, this is Tentacle Soft.
Thank you so much to everyone who played the demo of [Hellgate Reiko]!
Here’s what we’re planning to include in the next update.

1. Story Revision
Reiko is no longer a CEO, but a new employee. (For better event situations!)
During a late-night shift, she finds herself unable to leave the office due to a sudden appearance of a hellgate.
To go home, she must fight the monsters that appear on each floor and close the hellgates that cannot be shut unless you XX.

2. Costume System Update
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/2ccf4af0daff0a4dafc55796b718b8f7f444d59f.png[/img]
The costume change feature previously located in the inventory has been moved to the Point Shop.
Costumes can now be purchased and changed using points earned in-game.
(This system is still under development and may change.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/604d8215710d7f757fad4822c8a15b31ef840b48.gif[/img]

3. Weapon Draw UI Renewal
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/0d0f21702372f5b9c5305fc7a51b55dcbc0e5adc.png[/img]
To improve usability, we’ve updated the UI so you can choose where to place the weapon right when you draw it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/be058e268551f61ee11f065680ed1fb3e67d4661.gif[/img]

4. Settings Menu Enhancement
Volume control and keybinding settings have been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/7a036d4efad2a9247397c5b710d2592c46a15053.gif[/img]

Thank you again for all your support and feedback.
We’re sorry the update is taking time, but we’re working hard to bring you something better as soon as possible.
Thank you!

notes.title: Demo Update News! (2025-03-22)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/4387f226f03db699e0e7ce437a7a9528cca602e9.png[/img]

Hello, this is Tentacle Soft.

First of all, we sincerely thank everyone who has shown interest in our still-developing game.
We’ve released a new demo update based on our planned development schedule and the valuable feedback we’ve received from players.
We’re excited (and a bit nervous!) to finally share our first ECGs with you.

Demo Update Details:
1. Fixed a bug where the game would freeze when the inventory slots were full
2. Fixed a bug preventing the movement of 6-star weapons
3. Fixed a bug where units did not disappear after selling, allowing infinite gold duplication
- Also fixed an issue where dragging weapons over the DECK or CLOSE button triggered infinite selling
4. Added E key toggle for opening/closing the Pick (Inventory) window
5. Added 1280 resolution support for Steam Deck
6. Floor Paper improvements
- Now spawns 1 each of Bronze, Silver, and Gold
- Added Boss-grade Floor Paper (Boss Floor system will continue to be updated)
- At least one Boss must be selected to proceed through Boss Floor
- Bosses now appear on Floors 10 and 20
7. Added 2 ECGs
- Unlock ECG 01 by clearing Floor 10
- Unlock ECG 02 by clearing Floor 20
8. Fixed reward grade bugs and restructured the reward system
9. HP and recovery system overhaul
- Gain +1 HP at the end of each floor
10. Gold system overhaul
- Pick resource set to 500
- Adjusted gold rewards from defeating monsters
- Increased gold bonus for clearing stages
11. Rebalanced and reworked some relics
12. Changed the Start Bonus system into a Point Shop system
- Earn shop points by clearing Floors 5, 10, 15, and 20
- Use points before starting a run to enhance abilities or buy/change costumes
13. Added a Gate selection screen as the first step toward implementing game mode selection
- In addition to the base Classic mode, a new experimental Menhera mode with high randomness is in preparation

We’re thrilled to finally showcase ECGs to players.
In the full release, we plan to add not only ECGs but also a Dialogue Event system to enhance immersion.
The Dialogue system will take more time to implement, but we’re working steadily to bring it to life with solid quality.
As the story of “Reiko and the Gates of Hell” continues to evolve, some parts may change to better reflect new story ideas (we're thinking about more sweet and romantic Reiko routes!).

Next Update Goals:
1. Tutorial improvements
2. Add hover tooltips
3. Settings menu improvements
- Fix resolution issues
- Add volume settings
- Add key binding options
4. Allow players to view their deck after Game Over
5. Overhaul UI/system for card reward selection, upgrade, and removal
6. Change Floor Paper selection in Classic mode
- From current: 3 out of n → To: 1 out of 3
7. Add early version of Menhera mode

See you in the next update.
Thank you!

notes.title: Hellgate Reiko Demo Release Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, this is Tentacle Soft.

We are delighted to share some exciting news with you.

The demo version of Hellgate Reiko has successfully passed Steam’s review process and is now available for download.
Here’s what you can experience in this demo version:

1. A basic mode trial stage with randomly generated floor layouts for testing
2. 5 weapon types and 6 weapon grades
3. 20 relics
4. 8 starting options
5. 2 sexy standing CGs

This demo version serves as a test version of the game system, and we plan to release additional updates for the demo in the future.
Here are our planned updates:

1. A tutorial mode that includes detailed explanations of the game system
2. An additional trial stage (Hard mode) alongside the currently available basic mode trial stage
3. At least 30 relics added
4. A point-based starting option system
5. A gallery menu (including at least one event)

We are also working hard to bring you more updates regarding the full release version as soon as possible.

Although there is still much to improve, we truly appreciate your interest and support.
Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494965/ca7346c2375ee569503b940e187f4c29218f1423.gif[/img]
